bullet_facts.fact: Michael and Holly are in a romantic relationship and consider themselves very much in love.
Michael describes their relationship as being like Romeo and Juliet.
Holly and Michael have discussed long-distance dating due to Holly moving to Colorado.
Michael and Holly have shared kisses and expressed strong feelings for each other.
Michael proposed marriage to Holly in a humorous and romantic office scene.
Holly and Michael have experienced a breakup, with Michael stating he needs to break up on Valentine's Day.
